# Suggested repository labels

Create these labels in the GitHub UI (Settings → Labels). No Actions required.

| Label | Color (suggested) | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `documentation` | `#0E8A16` | Doc feedback and guide requests |
| `enhancement` | `#A2EEEF` | New guide requests |
| `needs-triage` | `#FBCA04` | Not yet reviewed by maintainers |
| `wontfix` | `#FFFFFF` | Declined (internal-only / out of scope) |
| `duplicate` | `#CFD3D7` | Already tracked |

Issue templates already apply `documentation` (and `enhancement` for guide requests).
